description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeParam', which extends 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform' to validate and transform name/value pairs in param tags for safe objects, specifically for Flash objects. It includes logic for specific attribute handling such as 'allowScriptAccess', 'allowNetworking', 'wmode', and 'movie'.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeParam
classes.description: A class to validate and transform parameters specific to safe Flash objects, ensuring only recognized name/value pairs are used and custom defaults are set.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SafeParam object, creating a URI attribute definition with embedded support.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms attributes by setting specific values based on attribute name, or nullifies unrecognized attributes.
